dedupe_keys.name: data source and aggregation scale sensitivity of urban morphology indicators reproducibility package

description: Data-Source and Aggregation-Scale Sensitivity of Urban Morphology Indicators: Reproducibility Package is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Lei Zhang, Bingshun Zhang (School of Architecture and Spatial Planning, Anhui Jianzhu University, Hefei 230601, Anhui, China). This archive provides the code, configurations, tests, processed analytical tables, figure-source data, statistical outputs, provenance records and audit materials supporting the study "Data-Source and Aggregation-Scale Sensitivity of Urban Morphology Indicators: A Four-City Comparison of OpenStreetMap and Microsoft Building Footprints". The study compares OpenStreetMap and Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints in Barcelona, Singapore, Melbourne and Tokyo. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
